legacy_cells.B: An intelligent framework for dynamic modeling of therapeutic response using clinical compliance data
legacy_cells.I: 027_2025_An intelligent framework for dynamic modeling of therapeutic response using clinical compliance data.pdf
legacy_cells.X: F2 EHR / ICU event & latent patient dynamics
legacy_cells.AN: Feature-presence mask; missing entries imputed using the posterior predictive distribution
legacy_cells.AT: Structured variational posterior q(z_t|z_<t,x_≤t,a_<t); GRU-based transition encoder
legacy_cells.BD: Dosage amount, administration frequency, delivery route; concurrent medication components
legacy_cells.BI: Hierarchical Therapeutic Transformer (HTT); Pharmacovigilant Inductive Strategy (PIS)
legacy_cells.BN: Pharmacological dose-response regularization; drug-interaction graph/Laplacian regularization
legacy_cells.BQ: Three-tier latent hierarchy: global patient traits, therapeutic trajectory, and local residual fluctuations
legacy_cells.BT: Task-specific decoder heads for regression and classification
legacy_cells.BV: ELBO; pharmacological, uncertainty-weighted reconstruction, masked reconstruction, task, graph, and robustness terms
legacy_cells.CA: 32 GB NVIDIA Tesla V100 GPUs; 200 training epochs
legacy_cells.FN: Reported classification results: MIMIC-IV accuracy 82.74%, AUC 87.66%; eICU-CRD (also called CaleICU-CRD in the text) accuracy 90.15%, AUC 91.05%; Open TG-GATEs accuracy 94.36%, AUC 96.12%; DrugCombDB accuracy 79.88%, AUC 83.66%. Despite temporal-state equations, results evaluate classification rather than forecasted state trajectories.
legacy_cells.FR: Methods formulate therapeutic latent transitions, but reported experiments are outcome/toxicity/synergy classification with accuracy/F1/AUC. They do not evaluate next-state fidelity, free-running trajectories, alternative-action rollouts, or clinical planning benefit. The paper contains inconsistent vision-task and dataset terminology; implementation-level temporal claims require further verification.
legacy_cells.FS: Reviewer mapping: M7 Outcome & causal layer; M9 Safety & governance
legacy_cells.FT: Reviewer lesson: Reuse the evaluated supporting estimator or audit behind a clear component boundary; validate its uncertainty and task limits again when connected to temporal dynamics.
legacy_cells.FX: Title/abstract (PDF p. 1); Introduction (pp. 2–3); Methods and architecture (pp. 4–12, including Tables 1–2 and Figures 1–4); experimental setup, results, benchmarking tables and ablations (pp. 13–17, Tables 3–6); conclusions, limitations, ethics and data statements (pp. 18–20). | Codex audit: title/byline, abstract/conclusion, targeted methods/results and cross-check of prior quotations against extracted full text. This is a targeted audit, not an independent re-extraction of every negative/unreported field.
legacy_cells.FZ: A:I were not changed because the PDF does not contradict the prefilled metadata. Although the methods specify medication-conditioned latent transitions, results mainly report classification benchmarks and ablations; no multistep action-conditioned rollout, alternative-action comparison, or planning result is demonstrated. Confidence is Medium because results/tables and discussion mix clinical claims with image-classification descriptions and benchmarks (including texture/vision language), creating an internal task-reporting inconsistency. Evidence QA: 16/36 populated fields had a <=25-word quotation matching extracted PDF text (44.4%). Confidence is conservative; review this row where exact quote checks were incomplete. Codex audit: 35 prior populated fields have a located source quotation; 1 have quotations not located by normalized text matching. Unlocated quotations are review flags, not proof that the value is false. Companion evidence audit lists affected columns. Reviewer FS/FT/FU mappings are synthesis. Prior unsupported/missing fields remain Not reported; no clinical benefit inferred from offline simulation.

limitations: Major architecture/evaluation attribution conflict: GRUtherapeuticlatentmodel versusCLIP/image-restoration/U-Net/videoaudio illustrations andResNetvisionclassifierprose.
CaleICU-CRD spelling/objectbackgroundprose andDrugCombDBtextureclassification make dataset/task linkage uncertain.
